independence: A separate program from the export, importing nothing from it or from the site-row exporter. It reads the served bytes, the release manifest and the files it pins, the A5 census and the A3 census that extends it, the MOABB catalog (the export reads the shortlist), i18n.ts as text, the payloads the new rows rest on and the external rows, and re-derives every site row's level, gaps and status from the censuses, every merge from the external rows, the counts from the rows (and against the counts the plan expects), and the CSV from the JSON.
